title: OutcomeBound validation result v1
description: What one attempt of one validation-plan claim observed, kept as .outcomebound-checks/<log stem>.<attempt>.result.json beside the attempt's log <log stem>.<attempt>.log. An attempt is never rewritten by a later one, so a failure's output survives a later pass. It records an observation; it is no proof that the result still holds, and `outcomebound validation status` reads the newest attempt to say which declared paths changed since.

cwd.description: The working directory the claim ran in, as an absolute path.

paths.description: The claim's declared `paths` when it ran, relative to cwd.

exit_code.description: The command's exit status; null where it did not run to an exit (not found, a refused path, a timeout).

log.description: The attempt's own log file name in the same folder (a copy of the output, never overwritten by a later attempt); null where it was not written.

started.description: UTC time the claim began, ISO 8601 with a trailing Z.

ended.description: UTC time the claim ended, ISO 8601 with a trailing Z.

plan_digest.description: SHA-256 of the plan file's bytes. Informational: `status` notes where the plan file differs from the run's.

head.description: The commit HEAD named at the claim's start; null outside a Git work tree with a commit.

dirty.description: The paths that differed from HEAD at the claim's start (tracked changes and untracked files Git does not ignore, relative to the repository root, without the check folder), each with a digest of its content; null where head is null.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes (of the link text for a link); `deleted` for a path that is gone; `unreadable` for one that is no readable file (a nested repository, a submodule), which is never known equal to anything.

claim_digest.description: SHA-256 of what decides how the claim ran and is judged: command, working directory, paths, required_paths, timeout_seconds, executes_tests and produces. A result stands only for the claim that has this digest.

environment.description: Each environment variable the claim names, as a SHA-256 of its value (null where unset); the value is never kept.

log_written.description: Whether this attempt's log was written. False means the log named in `log` is absent (it is then null): a PASS with false does not show that its output was kept.
